title: Raucle conformance record (raucle-conformance/v1)
description: Machine-checkable record of which published standards/ and docs/spec vector suites pass against a Raucle build, served at /.well-known/raucle-conformance and pinned by the CI conformance-data job.

tool_version.description: raucle.__version__ of the build the record was generated for.

all_passed.description: True only if every listed suite passed.

data_digest.description: sha256 of the record's full canonical JSON (indent=2, sort_keys) EXCLUDING this field; consumers can verify the artifact independently. CI pins it by re-running the generator and comparing bytes.

source.description: Repo-relative pytest target that verifies the vectors.

vectors.description: Number of published vectors in the suite (null when not file-derivable).

passed.description: True when that pytest target passed against this build.
